BusinessˆaccountsˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆonlyˆoffersˆpersonalˆaccounts.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆbusinessˆaccountsˆforˆcompanies,ˆpartnerships,ˆnonprofitsˆorˆsoleˆproprietors.ˆ##ˆUsingˆaˆpersonalˆaccountˆforˆbusinessˆPersonalˆaccountsˆareˆforˆpersonalˆuse.ˆSmallˆamountsˆofˆfreelanceˆorˆsideˆincomeˆareˆfine,ˆsuchˆasˆgettingˆpaidˆforˆoccasionalˆgigs.ˆRunningˆaˆbusiness'sˆregularˆpaymentsˆthroughˆaˆpersonalˆaccountˆisn'tˆallowed,ˆandˆcouldˆleadˆtoˆaˆreviewˆofˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆBusinessˆpaymentsˆintoˆyourˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆpaymentsˆfromˆaˆbusiness,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployerˆorˆaˆclient,ˆintoˆyourˆpersonalˆaccount.ˆ##ˆBusinessˆdebitˆcardsˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆisˆaˆpersonalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆcan'tˆcarryˆaˆbusinessˆname.ˆ##ˆTaxˆformsˆWeˆonlyˆissueˆinterestˆtaxˆforms.ˆWeˆcan'tˆissueˆformsˆforˆbusinessˆincome.ˆ##ˆLookingˆforˆaˆbusinessˆaccount?ˆYou'llˆneedˆaˆbankˆthatˆoffersˆbusinessˆaccounts.ˆWeˆcan'tˆrecommendˆaˆspecificˆone.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="support-no-advice">
FinancialˆadviceˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆexplainˆhowˆTallowbrookˆproductsˆwork,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆgiveˆfinancial,ˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadvice.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcan'tˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆWhetherˆtoˆinvest,ˆsaveˆorˆpayˆdownˆdebtˆ-ˆWhichˆstocks,ˆfundsˆorˆcryptocurrenciesˆtoˆbuyˆorˆsellˆ-ˆHowˆmuchˆofˆyourˆmoneyˆtoˆkeepˆinˆsavingsˆ-ˆHowˆtoˆreportˆinterestˆorˆotherˆincomeˆonˆyourˆtaxesˆ-ˆLegalˆquestionsˆaboutˆwills,ˆdivorceˆorˆdisputesˆwithˆotherˆpeopleˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆHowˆourˆsavingsˆratesˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆworkˆ-ˆFeesˆandˆlimitsˆonˆeachˆplan,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆdecideˆwhichˆsuitsˆyouˆ-ˆYourˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆgetˆadviceˆForˆadviceˆaboutˆyourˆsituation,ˆtalkˆtoˆaˆqualifiedˆfinancialˆadviser,ˆtaxˆprofessionalˆorˆlawyer.ˆ##ˆInvestingˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆinvestmentˆorˆbrokerageˆaccounts.ˆSeeˆ"Investingˆandˆcryptocurrency".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="disputes-how-to-file">
HowˆtoˆfileˆaˆdisputeˆMostˆdisputesˆcanˆbeˆfiledˆyourselfˆinˆtheˆappˆinˆaˆcoupleˆofˆminutes.ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆfileˆoneˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆFileˆitˆyourselfˆ1.ˆTapˆtheˆtransactionˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed.ˆ2.ˆTapˆGetˆhelpˆandˆchooseˆtheˆreason.ˆ3.ˆAnswerˆtheˆquestionsˆandˆaddˆanyˆdocuments.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆfileˆ-ˆTheˆtransactionˆmustˆhaveˆposted.ˆPendingˆtransactionsˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputed.ˆ-ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactions:ˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆdate,ˆandˆtheˆcardˆmustˆbeˆfrozenˆorˆreportedˆfirst.ˆ-ˆMerchantˆproblems:ˆwithinˆ120ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆtransactionˆdate,ˆafterˆcontactingˆtheˆmerchant.ˆ##ˆFilingˆthroughˆsupportˆSupportˆcanˆopenˆdisputesˆtotalingˆupˆtoˆ$5,000ˆperˆcase.ˆLargerˆcasesˆgoˆtoˆourˆDisputesˆteam,ˆwhoˆwillˆcontactˆyouˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆOneˆdisputeˆperˆtransactionˆIfˆaˆtransactionˆalreadyˆhasˆanˆopenˆdispute,ˆaddˆinformationˆtoˆthatˆcaseˆinsteadˆofˆopeningˆaˆnewˆone.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
